experiments.hypothesis: The exact finite checks preserve the current construction's claw and good-pair sets, ascending lane order and step3b outputs. The ordered tree has the stated exhaustive operation bounds. Its proven table-wide mean bound 7 uses H1's equal C1 mass per retained entry and first-six prefix retention; the ledger's charge 6.770000 is the declared measured premise H1W, which trial 11 estimates.
experiments.scope: Binding 12 x 2^19 table, six lanes, first-six retention, SEL window and kept CV class, reduced size. Trials 0..3 draw SHAKE first blocks until ((cv0>>24)&63)==12, choose r/ustart and 512 SEL sub-blocks from the seed, build from 2^17 consecutive u and scan 2^17 a0. Each candidate runs the combined tag/C1 test, ordered lane tree, postfilters and step3b. Tag claws are checked against an independent retained-entry search and real E16, C1 claws and every postfilter flag against real-word definitions. At about ten claws each they check semantics, not rates. Trial 4 is the positive P8 step3b control. Trial 5 exhausts tag classes and 16,128 C1 lane cases. Trial 6 checks 16 bitsliced batches against the scalar predicate and the 218-operation program bound. Trials 7 and 8 sample window rates on 2^15 C1/C2 draws and class F7 rates on 2^15 draws (16 cv0 values per group) from the trial seed alone, so a HASHSMASH_EXPERIMENT_HOLDOUT_NONCE rerun (FRONTIER_LANES.md:149) re-samples both. Trial 9 runs the actual walk on all 63 nonempty guard masks, checking order, additive charges 6,6,6,8,8,8 and maximum 18 per read. Trial 10 recomputes the integer ledger (H1W mean 6.770000, worst 18; H3B step-3b mean 842.485354, maximum 3,014 in vmax; one-time 2^24 initialization). Trial 11 estimates the walk mean per C1 claw (H1W) at 2^17 seed-drawn probes of synthetic buckets (Poisson(8), first six lanes in cyclic u order from a seeded ustart, uniform tags and PHI) through the actual walk, rechecking each fired lane against real-word tag and C1 definitions. Trials 4..255 return no pair; 12..255 report nothing. Appendix U scopes the base's 24 native 14-vs-filtered-15 comparisons, memory receipts and the exact census. Native 15-column/reference/bounded comparisons are evidence-only, never procedure phases or inputs; only the base's physical 14-column production runs witness the non-table online memory allowance.

experiments.hypothesis: The retained dense geometry and row/postfilter checks remain exact, and the fixed 12-column restriction with ordered lane enumeration preserves all ordered outputs. The finite walk and ledger controls agree with the separately stated proof and resource terms.
experiments.scope: The inherited dense and row controls. Trials 0..3 draw kept real first-block CVs from the seed, build a reduced dense u table and scan a reduced a0 range; claws, C1 claws, real E16 and postfilter flags are checked against independent definitions and both members are traced through the shallow rows. Trial 4 checks the known P8 step3b pair; trial 5 the fixed-size class-message sampler and real-word predicates. Trial 9 exhausts the ordered walk on all 63 nonempty masks (additive/prefix bounds, exact maximum 18). Trial 10 recomputes the integer ledger with the mean/worst walk charges and one-time initialization. Trials 6, 7 and 8 are the seed-drawn controls for H3-P1 (E[J] and E[J(J-1)]/E[J] of row-16 claw groups over 16 kept CVs), H7 (row-17 A/E-cell passes of 200 real-word pairs with and without row-16 conditioning) and H2b (pf_tail against the exact real-word reference pf_ref on the C2, G and F7 stages; 2^15 C1 draws with a0 uniform in W9). Trial 11 is the shallow state control for H8 and H9: 48 seed-drawn good pairs per side (a0 in SEL; a0 uniform in W9; SEL with cv0 in the kept class), cv[7] set so E16 lands on a row-16 target, row-17 A/E-cell passes of both members. Trial 12 (smcv) ports the H2b estimator's weighting and stopping rule: multilevel splitting over C2, G and F7 with the program's own samplers (weight = product of survival fractions), F7 particles traced as real messages through rows 17..21 with the one-sided stop (stop); pf_mis checks the levels against pf_ref, dir_mlog2 is a direct Monte Carlo of the same joint. Trial 13 (wcvd) extends trial 6: every row-16 claw of 16 kept CVs is classified by the depth it passes (C1, C2, G, F7 via pf_ref; rows 17..21 via the traces), with J and E[J(J-1)]/E[J] per depth and deepest (deepest depth with 30 or more events). Other trials return no pair. The checks do not measure the deep rare event (rows 22..37 remain the declared premises), prove H1 or establish native memory.
